provenance.what: the tpuv6e target as its MXU is: registers of 128 lanes x 8 words of 32 bits, an array of 256 x 256 (vcix-accelerator libtpu_mxu.so). The scratchpad is the same 128 MiB over half the lanes. The unit's queues hold 1024 rows each: what its delay line (4 x 128 - 1 cycles) lets out at two rows a cycle, so a pop may lag the pushes by the whole delay without a push ever waiting on it.
